items.description: One music-score asset reference row — a puck.music.v1 document's stable name, its file path (relative to BaseDirectory, the same convention WorldAddonRow.ModulePath already establishes for a machine-local asset shipped beside the executable), and the SHA-256 hex64 pin of the referenced document's own canonical bytes. Never embedded: the document is loaded, canonicalized, and hash-verified where it is compiled (Server.WorldServer's construction), the same load-then-pin discipline Puck.Text.FontAtlasSourceResolver.ResolvePinnedContained already applies to a font asset.

name.description: The row's stable name — its mutation address.

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the referenced document's canonical bytes.
